首页 > 口语题库 > 工作或学习

Part 1 必考 物品 OBJECTS

Work or Studies

工作或学习

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What work do you do?

Well, I'm actually still a student, studying Computer Science and Technology at university. So I don't have a job yet, but I treat my coursework as my main responsibility and spend most of my time programming.

我是学生，主修计算机科学与技术，学业即主业。

Q2Why did you choose to do that type of work (or that job)?

I chose this field mainly because I've been crazy about computers since I was a kid, you know, playing games and tinkering with the settings. That curiosity just naturally pushed me toward computer science, and I've never regretted that choice.

从小喜欢玩电脑、折腾设置，顺理成章选了计算机。

Q3Do you like your job?

Yeah, I really enjoy it, honestly. The thing is, I get to play with AI tools every day, which I genuinely love. Last week I even used an AI assistant to debug a project, and it saved me ages.

挺喜欢的，天天能玩 AI 工具，上周 AI 还帮我调试了项目。

Q4What requirements did you need to meet to get your current job?

Well, I'm not working yet, but to get into this program I needed decent grades in math and physics, plus a solid foundation in English. I mean, the entrance exam was pretty competitive, so I had to prepare quite seriously.

还没工作；进这专业靠数理化成绩加英语基础，入学考试竞争激烈。

Q5Do you have any plans for your work in the next five years?

Definitely, yeah. I plan to finish my degree first, and then I'd love to work as a software engineer, probably specializing in AI. I've actually been chatting with AI a lot lately, and that direction just feels right for me.

先读完学位，之后想当软件工程师，方向偏 AI。

Q6What do you think is the most important at the moment?

I'd say building solid programming fundamentals is the most important thing right now. You know, data structures and algorithms, because everything else builds on top of that. Honestly, without those basics, nothing else makes sense.

眼下最重要的是打牢编程基本功，比如数据结构和算法。

Q7Do you want to change to another job?

Not really, no. I'm quite happy with the path I've chosen, and switching now wouldn't make much sense. I mean, I've already invested so much time in programming, so I'd rather keep improving than start from scratch.

不想换，编程已投入很多时间，宁愿继续深耕。

Q8Do you miss being a student?

Ha, I'm actually still a student, so I don't miss it yet. But honestly, I can imagine missing this phase later, since student life is pretty relaxed compared to working full time.

我现在还是学生，还没资格怀念，但能想象以后会怀念。

Q9What technology do you use at work?

Well, since I'm a student, I mainly use a laptop and a tablet for studying. My laptop handles the heavy stuff like coding, and my tablet is handy for reading papers and taking notes in lectures.

学习主力是笔记本电脑和平板，电脑写代码、平板看文献。

Q10Who helps you the most? And how?

Definitely my girlfriend, without a doubt. She helps me a lot with my studies, mostly by encouraging me when I'm stuck or stressed about exams. Actually, her support really keeps me motivated to keep going.

女朋友帮最多，主要是在学习上鼓励我、给我打气。

Q11What subjects are you studying?

I'm studying Computer Science and Technology, so the subjects are mostly programming, data structures, operating systems, and things like that. We also have some math courses, like linear algebra and probability, which I find quite challenging actually.

学的都是编程、数据结构、操作系统，还有线性代数这类数学课。

Q12Do you like your subject?

Yeah, I really do. I mean, computer science lets me build things from nothing, which feels kind of magical. And these days I often talk to AI for assignments, which honestly makes learning way more fun.

喜欢，计算机能从零造出东西很神奇，加上常跟 AI 聊作业。

Q13Why did you choose to study that subject?

Well, honestly, I've loved playing with computers since I was little, you know, messing around with games and settings. So when it came to choosing a major, computer science just felt like the obvious choice for me.

小时候就爱摆弄电脑和游戏，选专业时计算机自然是首选。

Q14Do you think that your subject is popular in your country?

Oh, definitely, computer science is incredibly popular in China right now. Basically everyone sees it as a path to a well-paid job, so lots of students are rushing into it, which is both good and a bit worrying.

计算机在国内超火，大家觉得能拿高薪，都在往里挤。

Q15Do you have any plans for your studies in the next five years?

Yeah, I plan to finish my bachelor's degree and then probably do a master's, maybe abroad if I can manage it. I'm also hoping to work on some AI projects on the side, since that's where my real interest lies.

计划本科毕业后读研，可能出国，同时做点 AI 项目。

Q16What are the benefits of being your age?

I think the biggest benefit is having tons of energy and time to learn, you know, to make mistakes and fix them. Like, right now I can try all kinds of new things without too much pressure.

这个年纪最大的好处是精力足、试错成本低。

Q17Do you want to change your major?

No, not at all. I'm really into what I'm studying, especially the AI side of things, so changing majors never really crossed my mind. I mean, I chose this path because I love it, not because of any pressure.

完全不想换，尤其喜欢 AI 方向，是真心喜欢才选的。

Q18Do you prefer to study in the mornings or in the afternoons?

I'd say afternoons, definitely. I'm not really a morning person, so my brain doesn't fully wake up until around two o'clock. Actually, most of my productive coding sessions happen late in the afternoon or even in the evening.

更喜欢下午学习，不是晨型人，下午到晚上效率最高。

Q19How much time do you spend on your studies each week?

Quite a lot, honestly. I'd say around forty hours a week, which includes lectures, homework, and my own coding practice. Plus, I usually spend a couple of extra hours chatting with AI to figure out tricky concepts.

每周大约四十小时，加上用 AI 弄懂难题的时间。

Q20Are you looking forward to working?

Yeah, definitely, though I'm a bit nervous too. I'm excited to apply what I've learned in real projects and actually get paid for doing what I love. Still, working full time will be a whole new challenge.

期待工作，想把所学用到真实项目里，但也知道全职是挑战。

Q21What technology do you use when you study?

I mainly use my laptop and tablet when I study. The laptop is for coding, while the tablet is great for reading textbooks and taking notes. And I rely a lot on AI tools to explain things I don't understand.

电脑写代码加平板读教材记笔记，还常用 AI 工具答疑。

Q22What changes would you like to see in your school?

I'd love to see more hands-on projects and real-world case studies in our courses, you know, instead of just theory. Also, it would be great if the school offered more AI-related courses, since that's clearly where the industry is heading.

希望课程多点实战项目，并开设更多 AI 相关课程。
